question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is: **advice**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is in context to the fact that the author never passes judgement on those who seek his **counsel**.
 
• **Advice**: an opinion that you give somebody about what he/she should do.
 
• The rest of the options are grammatically incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is: I never judge people who come to me for ***advice***__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The meanings of the rest of the options are given below in the table:

 
 

 **Word**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 **News**
 

 information about something that has happened recently
 
 

 **Lesson**
 a period of time when you learn or teach something
 
 

 **Caution**
 great care, because of possible danger
